confirmedSafetyAndIdentityControls: Source/ABI inspection found Win32 getters and enumeration APIs only. The only SPI actions are GETWORKAREA 0x30 and GETHIGHCONTRAST 0x42; no display, input, theme or DPI setters are imported.

Rect 16, MONITORINFOEXW 104, DISPLAY_DEVICEW 840, DEVMODEW 220 and HIGHCONTRASTW 16-byte x64 layouts were statically reviewed and have runtime size assertions. PInvoke behaviour itself has not yet been exercised.

The GET-returned HC scheme pointer is copied with a finite UTF-16 bound, preserves NULL/EMPTY/NAMED, and is released with LocalFree in finally. The owned input-desktop handle is closed; borrowed thread-desktop/window-station handles are not closed.

The console apphost declares System DPI awareness without a setter, creates no window, references no UI framework and rejects loaded WPF/Windows Forms assemblies. CREATE_NO_WINDOW avoids a console window.

The classifier accepts its geometry inference only for observed System-aware process/thread state, one primary monitor, 96 DPI/100-percent scaling, consistent physical mode/work-area rectangles and adequate tracking limits. It expressly does not measure a WPF window.
Two fixed snapshots must agree after excluding only their monotonic clocks. They are observations, not a restoration round trip or retry-until-pass loop.

Exact owner/repository/branch/attempt/source guards and a clean checkout precede discovery. Original full image/OS/UBR identity and SDK identity files are checked before building or launching the probe.

The apphost pins Core 10.0.14 with roll-forward disabled. Loaded Core SHA256 and self/binary/source identities are checked after the read-only child and before its eligibility result is accepted. This is not a claim that all loaded-runtime checks precede the Win32 reads.
The discovery workflow excludes all five existing jobs. It has no qualification command, matrix, API-token environment or runtime installation step; checkout credentials are not persisted.
The historical coordinator CLI and execute entry point reject spent authority before restore, Windows imports or child launch. Frozen qualification source and bundles remain unchanged.

Infrastructure eligibility is always BLOCKED, restoration remains UNVERIFIED and campaignExecutionApproved remains false. The pure continuation proposal is explicitly not wired into the frozen launcher.
limitsAndRequiredFollowThrough: Seal the reviewed content, verify every listed Git-filtered blob identity after commit, then dispatch using the actual live HEAD as expected_infrastructure_sha. Evidence-only additions do not authorise executable changes.

Discovery can fail on API/resource unavailability, image drift or an incompatible runtime. Retain its first failure; do not substitute a host, install a runtime or mutate display/appearance to obtain a pass.
An ELIGIBLE geometry field is a narrow 96-DPI diagnostic inference, not campaign eligibility, actual WPF measurement, foreground/input viability, compositor evidence or a product support limit.

Active theme identity and selected Win32 colour readings are additional bounded evidence. Stable reads do not prove complete visual state restoration, and NULL/empty setter semantics remain unvalidated.
Actual discovery artefacts, process identity and source/binary hashes still require independent final review. No new R01/R02 authority follows from a successful discovery job.

A future live appearance/display experiment and later gate integration require separately reviewed scope, evidence and explicit owner authority. The original failed R01, historical High Contrast failure and 250 ms policy remain unchanged.
